paper_title: Searches for electron interactions induced by new physics in the EDELWEISS-III germanium bolometers
notes: Paper sets multiple limits: solar axion g_ae<1.1e-11 (massless limit), g_ae x g_aN^eff<3.5e-17, electron lifetime, and bosonic DM absorption (ALP g_ae and hidden photon kinetic mixing) over 0.8-500 keV. Primary mass-dependent exclusion plot (Fig. 5 left) is ALP DM coupling g_ae => AxionElectron. Data points are approximate reads from described mass range since no numerical table is provided; exact y-axis values not given in text. Local DM density rho_DM=0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed. Note paper also has DarkPhoton (kinetic mixing) result in Fig 5 right; coupling type ambiguity lowers confidence.
